title: pvMinMax
body:
## pvMinMax

Computes, for every point and cell array of the input, the componentwise minimum, maximum or sum over all tuples, and outputs a polydata with exactly one point and one vertex cell that carries the results under the original array names. Use it for one-number summaries such as peak temperature. In parallel runs ghost arrays are needed to avoid double counting. For cell-size-weighted totals use integrate; for distributions use pvHistogram.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- SUM adds raw tuple values; it is not an integral and ignores cell sizes.
- Operation must be MIN, MAX or SUM in upper case; any other string makes the native filter report an error and fall back to MIN.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MinMax`. Identity: `filters/MinMax`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Min Max filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Operation` | Select whether to perform a min, max, or sum operation on the data. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

```json
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvMinMax",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
